result.headline: Actuator output ch[4] froze at 1500 us from 49.7 s with no event; attitude still tracked afterwards.
result.explanation: The only onset-type fault is ch[4] holding 1500 us from 49.711 s to the end, with no mode change. The recording cannot show who stopped it, or whether ch[4] was the surface needed.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT actuator.output[ch[4]] held 1500 from t=49.711 to 81.163 s (94 samples)
evidence.shows: ch[4] stopped moving at 49.711 s and stayed at 1500 us to the end; its spread went from 11.5 to 0.0.

evidence.quote: ANOMALY a12 t=49.711 s: actuator.output[ch[4]] was moving, then held 1500 for 31.452 s (see line 25; strength 3.778)
evidence.shows: The freeze is the strongest onset-type anomaly. Nothing else changed at that time, and no events fall in the window.

evidence.quote: ROLE actuator.output[ch[2]] follows propulsion.throttle (correlation 0.994 over the recording): it serves that loop
evidence.shows: The level shifts near 5.5 s on ch[2], throttle and pitch setpoint move together. This looks like a commanded change, not a fault.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT vehicle.airspeed = 0 for the whole recording (999 samples)
evidence.shows: Airspeed reads 0 throughout. It is constant from the start, so it is a sensor or logging gap, not a fault onset.

checked.result: Only ch[4] froze. Yaw, pitch and roll tracking error ratios were 1.38, 1.14 and 0.76, so no tracking degradation.
checked.about: Actuator ch[4] freeze as the only onset-type change

checked.check: ch[4] against the roll, yaw and pitch setpoints before the freeze
checked.result: Roll correlation 0.324 (0.588 at a -1.359 s lag). Yaw -0.139 and pitch -0.068, both weak. ch[4] has no ROLE line.

checked.check: Attitude against setpoint from 40 to 81 s
checked.result: Yaw follows the setpoint (-117.978 vs -117 at 53.736 s, 118.279 vs 127 at 77.573 s). Roll roughly follows, with large excursions.
checked.about: The freeze caused loss of control

checked.check: Sequence of departures from baseline in 3 to 9 s
checked.result: Pitch setpoint left baseline first (4.836 s), then ch[1] and ch[2] (5.15 s), then throttle (5.456 s). Setpoint-led, outputs following.
checked.about: The 5 s shifts as a fault

checked.result: Two events, both at 0.273 s (low-voltage warning, sensor health error), so start-up. No earlier cases apply.
